floater.name: wolf_track
floater.title: Lay Railway Track
floater.floater.string: Lay Railway Track - changing a railway
floater.text: 1. Draw your railway - what do your clicks make?

radio_group.name: track_mode
radio_group.tool_tip: Each choice makes something different with your next clicks on the ground. The words at the top of the world view say what to click.

radio_item.label: A line
radio_item.name: line
radio_item.tool_tip: Click where the line starts, at each bend, and where it ends. Click the first point again to make a loop.

radio_item.label: A branch
radio_item.name: branch
radio_item.tool_tip: Click on a line where the branch leaves it, then its bends and its end. End it on a line to join that line.

radio_item.label: A station
radio_item.name: station
radio_item.tool_tip: Click on a line where the platform starts, then where it ends.

radio_item.label: A signal
radio_item.name: signal
radio_item.tool_tip: Click on a line to put a signal there. Signals are also put in by themselves.

button.label: Undo last point
button.name: track_undo
button.tool_tip: Take the last point you clicked back (Backspace)

button.label: Finish this line
button.name: track_finish
button.tool_tip: End the line you are drawing here; your next click starts a new line

button.label: Start over
button.name: track_start_over
button.tool_tip: Clear the whole drawing (the window asks first)

button.label: Look down
button.name: track_top_view
button.tool_tip: Turn the camera to look down on your drawing, so a click lands where you point

combo_box.name: station_side
combo_box.tool_tip: Which side of the line the platform is on, looking the way you drew the line. Island: the line splits round a platform in the middle.

line_editor.label: Station name
line_editor.name: station_name
line_editor.tool_tip: The station's name, up to 24 letters, digits, spaces, apostrophes or hyphens - for example Badger Hill

floater.text: What you have drawn (pick one to change or take it out):

button.label: Take out
button.name: track_take_out
button.tool_tip: Take the line, branch, station or signal picked in the list out of the drawing

button.label: Lay track
button.name: track_lay
button.tool_tip: Make the track, stations and signals and put them on your land (free)

button.label: Lay the next part
button.name: track_next_part
button.tool_tip: Put the part of your railway that is in the region you are in now on the land

button.label: Look again
button.name: track_look_again
button.tool_tip: Look again for the pieces that have not appeared yet

button.label: Take away what was placed
button.name: track_take_away
button.tool_tip: Take away the pieces that did appear (the railway stays in your inventory, in Objects)

check_box.label: Your railways in this region
check_box.name: track_mine_check
check_box.tool_tip: Show the railways you have laid in this region, to show, change or remove them

button.label: Show
button.name: track_show
button.tool_tip: Draw this railway's plan in the world

button.label: Change
button.name: track_change
button.tool_tip: Load this railway into the drawing. Lay track then lays the changed railway, and the old one is taken away once the new one is in place.

button.label: Lay its part here
button.name: track_lay_part
button.tool_tip: Put the part of this railway that is in the region you are in on the land

button.label: Remove
button.name: track_remove
button.tool_tip: Take this railway's pieces away from the region you are in (the window asks first)
